Call Out.descriptionOnly: no path: its Intimidate DC is 10 + the target's Hit Dice + its Wisdom modifier (or its Sense Motive bonus)

Improved Parry.descriptionOnly: no path: the parried foe loses its Dexterity bonus to AC against its next melee attack

Leapfrog.descriptionOnly: no path: the +2 is on its swift performance combat check, the +4 on its next Acrobatics, Climb, Fly, Ride or Swim check

Second Wind.descriptionOnly: no path: the +2 is on the performance combat check it makes as a swift action
